package main

import (
    "context"
    "sync"
    "testing"
    "time"
)

func TestCompiledProgramFactoriesDoNotRewriteRunningMetadata(t *testing.T) {
    start := make(chan struct{})
    var workers sync.WaitGroup
    for worker := 0; worker < 4; worker++ {
        workers.Add(1)
        go func() {
            defer workers.Done()
            <-start
            for i := 0; i < 50; i++ {
                program, err := generatedProgram(Host{})
                if err != nil { t.Error(err); return }
                owner, later := program.syntax.body.items[0], program.syntax.body.items[1]
                child := program.syntax.flows["Child"].body.items[0]
                target := Position{{owner.tok.site,"0"},{owner.expr.tok.site,"0"},{child.tok.site,"0"}}
                after := After{
                    Target: ListValue(textValue("node"),target.Wire()),
                    Requires: ListValue(textValue("node"),Position{{later.tok.site,"0"}}.Wire()),
                }
                report, err := program.Run(context.Background(), nil, Options{After: []After{after}})
                if err != nil {
                    t.Error(err); return
                }
                if report.Output.n != 5 { t.Error("incorrect child output"); return }
                positions := map[string]bool{}
                for _, n := range report.Nodes {
                    key := identityKey(n.Position.Wire())
                    if positions[key] { t.Error("source/body position collision"); return }
                    positions[key] = true
                }
            }
        }()
    }
    close(start)
    workers.Wait()
}

func TestCompiledHostCapabilitiesFrozen(t *testing.T) {
	host := Host{Capabilities: map[string]bool{"read": true}}
	program, err := generatedProgram(host)
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	host.Capabilities["read"] = false
	if !program.host.Capabilities["read"] { t.Fatal("compiled registry aliases the caller's capabilities") }
}

func TestClaimConflictRetainsVariantsAndHistoricalSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	store := newClaimStore("run")
	position := Position{{1, "0"}}
	if err := store.join(position, number(1)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	before, err := store.read()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = store.join(position, number(2)); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted changing identity")
	}
	if _, err = store.read(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("read conflicted store")
	}
	if len(store.variants[identityKey(joinWire("run", position))]) != 2 || before.l[0].o["value"].n != 1 {
		t.Fatal("conflict lost facts or changed a snapshot")
	}
}

func TestClaimNaNRedeliveryUsesCanonicalIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	store := newClaimStore("nan-run")
	position := Position{{1,"0"}}
	value := object(map[string]Value{"x":ListValue(nanValue())})
	for i:=0;i<3;i++ { if err:=store.join(position,value);err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)} }
	if snapshot,err:=store.read();err!=nil || len(snapshot.l)!=1 {t.Fatal(snapshot,err)}
	if equal,_:=Equal(value,value);equal {t.Fatal("language equality must remain false")}
	if err:=store.join(position,object(map[string]Value{"x":ListValue(textValue("nan"))}));err==nil {t.Fatal("NaN and string conflated")}
}

func TestClaimInfinitySignsRemainDistinct(t *testing.T) {
    for _, value := range []Value{infValue(),number(-infValue().n)} {
        store := newClaimStore("inf-run")
        position := Position{{1,"0"}}
        if err := store.join(position,value); err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
        if err := store.join(position,value); err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
        if snapshot,err := store.read(); err != nil || len(snapshot.l)!=1 {t.Fatal(snapshot,err)}
        if err := store.join(position,number(-value.n)); err == nil {t.Fatal("infinity signs conflated")}
    }
}

func TestIndependentOperationPermitsMakeProgress(t *testing.T) {
	ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool:=NewResourcePool(nil)
	release,err:=pool.acquire(ctx,nil,"busy")
	if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
	defer release()
	done:=make(chan struct{})
	go func(){defer close(done);release,err:=pool.acquire(ctx,nil,"busy");if err==nil {release()}}()
	for {
		pool.mu.Lock(); waiting:=len(pool.queue)>0;pool.mu.Unlock()
		if waiting {break}
		if ctx.Err()!=nil {t.Fatal(ctx.Err())}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
	other,err:=pool.acquire(ctx,nil,"independent")
	if err!=nil {t.Fatal("independent operation blocked behind busy operation",err)}
	other()
	cancel()
	<-done
}
